summary.intent: Check project progress after pulling latest changes, determine what phase to work on next, and gather implementation context for Phase 26 (Observability & UX Tuning) via an interactive discussion session.
summary.outcome: Successfully identified Phase 26 as the next actionable phase (24 and 25 are in PR review), completed the discuss-phase workflow with all four gray areas covered, and created `.planning/phases/26-observability-ux-tuning/26-CONTEXT.md` committed to a new feature branch.

repo: Phases 24 and 25 were in PR review at time of session — Phase 26 is the active next phase
Phase 18 explicitly deferred Grafana alerting as 'observation only, alerts premature before baselines' — Phase 26 is the payoff for that deferral
Single Grafana dashboard strategy: all panels extend `docker/grafana/dashboards/cipherbox-staging.json` rather than creating per-phase dashboards
Alloy config scrapes both API `/metrics` (30s) and Kubo `/debug/metrics/prometheus` (30s), ships to Grafana Cloud Mimir/Loki
5 histograms already instrumented: HTTP request duration, IPFS/IPNS general, republish batch, IPNS resolve, IPNS publish
Client-side perf instrumentation (`packages/sdk-core/src/perf.ts`) is non-production only — gated on `NODE_ENV !== 'production'` or `globalThis.__CIPHERBOX_PERF__ === true`
Existing timeouts: Kubo 30s, Pinata 60s, PSA 30s, delegated routing 10s, TEE 30s, connection probe 5s
Upload service already has 3-retry exponential backoff with user-cancellation bypass
Delegated routing client has comprehensive retry: 3 attempts, respects `Retry-After` header for 429s, exponential backoff for network errors
Auth refresh uses shared promise pattern to deduplicate concurrent 401 handlers
Performance baselines live in `.planning/baselines/` — 6 files covering phases 18, 19, 19.2, 21, 22
13 pending todos in the planning system

code.finding: 5 Gauges (DB-polled every 30s), 8+ Counters (event-driven), 5 Histograms (operation timing) — full Prometheus registry for the API
Records all HTTP requests per-route/method/status using process.hrtime.bigint(); excludes /metrics endpoint; normalizes UUID/CID paths to keep cardinality low
Performance instrumentation gated to non-production only; uses markStart/markEnd/withPerf helpers; marks format: cipherbox:<operation>:<id>:start/end
Most comprehensive retry pattern in the codebase: 3 attempts, 1s base delay, 30s max delay, Retry-After header support for 429s, primary+fallback endpoint strategy, 10s per-request timeout
401 handler uses shared refresh promise to prevent duplicate concurrent refresh calls; refresh endpoint itself never retries to avoid infinite loops
Alloy scrapes API /metrics and Kubo /debug/metrics/prometheus every 30s; ships to Grafana Cloud Mimir and Loki

workflow: GSD `discuss-phase` workflow runs a codebase scout via subagent before presenting gray areas — this correctly informed which timeout values already exist
Feature branch created mid-workflow while waiting for async codebase scout to complete — good parallel work pattern
Progress check revealed phases under PR review should be skipped when determining 'next up' — the GSD progress command doesn't account for in-review status automatically

friction: GSD progress routing suggested Phase 24 as next up, but phases 24 and 25 were already in PR review — required manual clarification from the user to skip ahead to Phase 26
Codebase scout ran as an async subagent, requiring a task-notification round-trip before gray area discussion could begin
